ZinWaylandTransport.Handle: Opaque transport-level transferable handle. On Linux/BSD it wraps an fd; on brixOS it may wrap a native transferable handle.
ZinWaylandTransport.MessageAtomicity: The library must preserve byte ordering and associate received ancillary handles with the message arguments that consume them, including partial stream reads/writes.
ZinWaylandTransport.Buffering: Transport may buffer without heap allocation only when caller-provided buffers suffice; otherwise explicit allocator ownership is required.
ZinWaylandTransport.Wait: Must integrate with target event wait primitive and support multiple connections/listeners.
ZinWaylandTransport.SharedMemory: Must allow a compositor and client to map the same exported memory object with explicit lifetime management.
